figurative_meaning_en: Fourteen generations of ancestors upwards from the grandfather
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা চোদ্দপুরুষ ধরে এই পেশায় আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This house has been in the family for fourteen generations.
They have been in this profession for fourteen generations.
note: Refers to a long ancestral lineage, emphasizing continuity over many generations in Bengali familial contexts.
